## collection_date
**10 run(s)** — rule `meyer20-date` — 10.1111/tpj.13419  
*Methods S1 (tpj13419-sup-0023-methods1.docx), 'validation experiment' paragraph*

> For the validation experiment, maize inbred line B73 was PLANTED IN DECEMBER 2012 in three replicate rows of 10 plants each at Hildesheim Research Station, PANNAR SEED Pty Ltd, Greytown, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Hildesheim is situated 96 km from Baynesfield Estate, and is a site of regular GLS disease screening due to favourable conditions for GLS disease, and therefore plants were subject to NATURAL INOCULUM of C. zeina. The year is in Methods S1 alone: the article body describes this trial three times and defers to Methods S1 every time, and the only year in the body (2008/2009) belongs to the SEPARATE Baynesfield RIL microarray trial 96 km away. Two deposits draw on this one planting. Swart et al. 2017 (PRJNA369690) says its RNA-seq material was 'the same as described by Christie et al. (2017)' and Christie sampled at 77 DAP; Meyer et al. 2020 (PRJNA564795) says 'GLS disease and RNAseq data from the B73 plants in THIS FIELD TRIAL have been reported by Christie et al. (2017) and Swart et al. (2017) ... the current study used data from the B73-QTL plants', assessed at five time points from 66 to 103 DAP. Planting anywhere in December 2012 plus 66 to 103 days falls between 5 February and 13 April 2013, so both deposits are 2013 at year precision and neither is 2012, which is the PLANTING year rather than the collection year.
